name: @aeon-framework/compiler
description: Aeon AOT compiler: whole-project static analysis (real binding-kind validation, unused @aeon-framework/* imports, unreachable routes) powering `aeon check`, plus a build-time esbuild plugin (aeonPrecompile) that runs the real template compiler at build time so `aeon build` output skips one tree-walk per template shape on first render. Not whole-program dead-code elimination — that remains a further-out milestone.
